C08 and C18 employ essentially the same machinery and language, but each concerns only one drug, making C20 the closer structural match to the child's five-drug proclamation.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Whereas section 3228 (f) of the Internal Revenue Code provides in part as follows: Opiate.
